name: MARR S.p.A.
summary: MARR S.p.A. engages in marketing and distribution of fresh, dried, and frozen food products for catering in Italy, the European Union, and internationally. It offers meat products, such as beef, sheep, pork, poultry, and rabbit families products; seafood products, including fresh and frozen seafood products; grocery products; cured meats and cheeses; and wine and beverages, such as liqueurs, bitters, grappa, classic and craft beers, drinks, which include juices, soft drinks, infusions, and tea.
